pillars: Build tools you personally want to use
AI tools that empower non-tech business owners

plays.title: Revenue Milestone Transparency
plays.description: Share exact AI token usage, costs, and MRR gains (plus smaller wins) in a clear format with AMA to build massive credibility and engagement through radical transparency.
plays.action:
1. Track tokens used, subscription-based costs, and MRR deltas monthly.
2. Post in this exact multi-line style with a dashboard screenshot: "I used ~25B tokens last month

~$15,000 cost

Gained $157 MRR

AMA"
3. Reply to comments with clarifications (e.g. "estimated cost based on the subscription plan", "delivered the value of ~6 months what the team of 10 would have done", "claude code only").
4. Separately post small wins immediately: "$100 MRR 🫡".

plays.title: Feature-as-Marketing Ship Loop
plays.description: Turn every meaningful product publish, update, and future vision into high-signal content that markets the product while it ships.
plays.action:
1. When you publish or significantly advance a product (e.g. makeawebsite.app), immediately post a short authentic update.
2. Include excitement, what it enables for users, and concrete next steps.
3. Example structure: "My make website app is published. Next steps are ASO and dancing on TikTok 🕺😩🕺" or the full vision post.
4. Always add a link or feedback ask.

plays.title: Share AI Planning Best Practices
plays.description: Teach the audience to front-load big projects with dedicated planning agents (Fable) before heavy implementation (Opus / Claude Code) to avoid massive token waste.
plays.action:
1. Before coding large features, spend one or more full days planning the roadmap inside a planning AI tool.
2. Post the reminder exactly like this: "One more day on Fable 5.

Reminder to use it to PLAN big tasks in advance so we have months' worth of implementation time for Opus

Otherwise you are WASTING TOKENS!!!"
3. Add context from your current projects when relevant.

plays.title: Broadcast Non-Tech AI Product Vision
plays.description: Publicly articulate the complete long-term vision for AI tools that let non-technical business owners run their entire online presence.
plays.action:
1. When the vision for the next phase is clear, post with genuine excitement.
2. Use this structure: "Excited to see how this turns out 😁

I want to make it possible for non-tech business owners to run their entire online presence with AI via a simple app.

Starting with helping them make a website, and then other stuff like geo SEO, posting updates on social media pages, managing their Google Maps / Google Business, etc"
3. Attach a screenshot and link to the current live product (makeawebsite.app).

hooks: Excited to see how this turns out 😁
I want to make it possible for non-tech business owners to run their entire online presence with AI via a simple app.
angles: Radical transparency on exact AI token spend, dollar costs, and MRR produced
Planning extensively with agents before expensive implementation to control costs
Solo AI development delivering the value of large traditional dev teams
Dead-simple AI apps that let non-technical owners handle websites, SEO, social, and Google Business
Public celebration of both huge usage numbers and every small revenue milestone
